_provenance: Real capture: POST https://getamber.dev/api/a2a against a live production agent ('Ambr', found via a2aregistry.org), 2026-07-07. Uses underscores instead of the spec's hyphens for compound state names -- "input_required" instead of "input-required". This was the first real agent all session to naturally need a multi-turn input-required resolution; before this fix, the state was invisible to both assertions.py's known-state checks AND prober.py's CONTINUABLE_STATES check, so the prober never attempted a follow-up at all.
